purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian beverage/distribution company returns-by-responsibility report (Devoluções por Responsabilidade); tracks product returns categorized by responsible party (sales, finance/admin, transport, market, process)
purpose.summary: Batch report program PW02175R generates a 'Returns by Responsibility' report for a Brazilian distribution/beverage company. It reads indexed work files containing return and billing data, aggregates quantities by responsibility category (sales, transport, commercial, etc.), and produces formatted output with percentage breakdowns. The program supports multiple report layout options (general, commercial, sales manager, area/sector, supervisor/salesperson, map, carrier, district manager).
